materials.role: fruit body field — the golden ovoid skin between the eyes
materials.rationale: The dominant warm-gold mass between the diamonds reads as muted, earthy ripe fruit (not glossy toy-yellow); terracotta's matte grain matches the body's soft, non-shiny surface.

materials.role: diamond 'eyes' lattice — the raised orange cross/plus motifs
materials.rationale: The staggered raised plus-shapes are a distinct deeper orange than the body field — a near-tone but separate material giving the pineapple-skin lattice its depth; kept distinct so the eyes don't collapse into the gold body.

materials.role: leaf crown blades — the radiating green fins
materials.rationale: The crown is the top mass and the one cool note; the saturated, flat-faced green fins read as concrete's clean matte saturation, popping against the warm body.

materials.role: leaf highlight tips — the bright lime caps on the tallest blades
materials.rationale: Only the outermost blade tips show a lighter, yellower lime than the body of the leaves — a sparing highlight accent kept distinct from the darker green_concrete crown so the leaf tips catch light.

materials.role: plinth disc — the flattened base course under the body
materials.rationale: The slightly wider footing course at the bottom shares the body's gold material but functions as a separate stabilizing plinth region beneath the fruit mass.
